translations.web: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.
translations.bsb: “Which way did he go?” their father asked. And his sons showed him the way taken by the man of God, who had come from Judah.
translations.kjv: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.
translations.asv: And their father said unto them, What way went he? Now his sons had seen what way the man of God went, that came from Judah.
